description: This file defines utility functions, classes, and callbacks for testing the disk cache component in Chromium, including cache file creation, deletion, integrity checks, and handling asynchronous IO operations with callbacks and message loops.

classes.name: TestBackendResultCompletionCallback
classes.description: A callback class for handling backend result completion in cache tests.

classes.name: TestEntryResultCompletionCallback
classes.description: A callback class for handling entry result completion in cache tests.

classes.name: TestRangeResultCompletionCallback
classes.description: A callback class for handling range result completion in cache tests.

classes.name: MessageLoopHelper
classes.description: A helper class to manage message loop execution and synchronization during cache tests.

classes.name: CallbackTest
classes.description: A class to process IO completion callbacks in cache tests.

methods.name: CreateCacheTestFile
methods.description: Creates a test file in the cache directory.

methods.name: DeleteCache
methods.description: Deletes all files in the cache directory.

methods.name: CacheTestFillBuffer
methods.description: Fills a buffer with random data for testing.

methods.name: GenerateKey
methods.description: Generates a random key string of up to 200 bytes.

methods.name: CheckCacheIntegrity
methods.description: Checks if the cache is not corrupt, optionally setting max size.

methods.name: TestBackendResultCompletionCallback
methods.description: Handles completion callback for backend results.

methods.name: TestEntryResultCompletionCallback
methods.description: Handles completion callback for entry results.

methods.name: TestRangeResultCompletionCallback
methods.description: Handles completion callback for range results.

methods.name: MessageLoopHelper
methods.description: Manages message loop execution and synchronization for cache tests.

methods.name: CallbackTest
methods.description: Processes IO completion callbacks during cache testing.
